title: crystal teaches the mandala
story: A slow salsa romantica intro (Frankie Ruiz, La Cura, 95.7 BPM feel): a solo chord-like opening hit at 24 blooms the crystal, then the mandala turns slowly with its twist opening over four bars. At 168 the band enters and brazos steps once; from there the drums' strokes and open tones pulse the nitidez and the twist on each hit, colour moves per bar, and the two-beat contrast steps keep the groove steady.
